page.layout: One page of text: running head at top right with page number; one block of running French text ending in the letter's greeting; a right-indented signature block; a place and date line; a gathering mark at the lower right. Show-through from the reverse side runs faintly through the lower half and is not transcribed.

main_text.l: retenir la connoissance: A quoy vostre credit,
i'ose esperer, que vous ne la refuserez pas, à
la tres-humble priere que ie vous en fais, estant
d'ailleurs asseuré du zele & affection, que vous
auez, pour conseruer & faire fleurir auec honneur,
cette belle, & precieuse science de la Medecine,
auec laquelle vous obligez si heureusement toute
la France, & toute l'Eglise de Dieu, par la con-
seruation de la santé du Roy. Cependant ie

page.notes: Faint show-through from the reverse page runs through the lower half of the page (fragments such as "Medecine", "science", "Dieu") and was left out. The final mark of "Montpelier" and the date line are doubtful as to punctuation ("Montpelier;" read as a semicolon). The page has heavy foxing and a dark stain near the lower left of the text, not affecting any word. The gathering mark at the lower right is read as "T". The long s is written as a plain s throughout.
